other_conditions: Both members of the couple must be permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh for at least five years
Neither member of the couple should have any criminal conviction
The marriage must be registered with the Registrar of the State
At least one member of the couple must have a disability of at least 40%
No member of the couple should be an income taxpayer
benefits_summary: Provides ₹15,000 for a disabled man, ₹20,000 for a disabled woman, or ₹35,000 if both partners are disabled.
documents_required: Hard copy of the online application form
